read_file: read a text file with line numbers and pagination using offset and limit parameters
write_file: write content to a file, creating parent directories and overwriting existing content
patch_file: patch a file using find-and-replace or V4A multi-file patch format with fuzzy matching
search_files: search file contents with regex or find files by glob pattern using ripgrep-backed search
reset_file_dedup: clear the deduplication cache for file reads after context compression
